name: BSP_MultiSessionBrowserScreen_Register
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this), primary vtable slot +10h of 00CEF134. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Register (004F71D0) and builds the browser's widget and texture bindings: it references globals.no_server_found and composes gui/radarshots/ paths with the suffixes _C.tga, _D.tga, _E.tga, _S.tga, _ICS.tga, _ICM.tga, _ICL.tga and _ICH.tga through BSP_NativeString_Concat and BSP_NativeString_Substring. Body past the registration was not read. docs/MULTI_MENU_SCREENS.md
